claims.text: South of the Second Pylon, incorporated into the later Great Court.
Ramesses III built a festival bark station with three divine bark chambers. A small pylon leads to a statue-lined court, vestibule and hypostyle hall.
The temple stands perpendicular to the main east–west processional route; its chambers served Amun, Mut and Khonsu.
